description: Pax于1956年推出的旁轴相机。配备Luminor Anastigmat 1:3.5 F=45 mm; a coated triplet.。快门速度**Rim-set leaf shutter. 1/10 - 1/300 sec plus B. Cocked by film advance. No delayed action. Shutter-cocked indicator (red spot in window on top of the lens).。使用24x36mm on 135 cartridge film.。**Coupled rangefinder in superstructure on the top plate, giving double-image focusing in the viewfinder (cf the Pax 35 which has separate VF and RF). Rangefinder baseline approx. 40 mm.。
